description: This source file defines the SystemCheckException class used within the OrangeHRM installer module, specifically handling exceptions related to system checks during the installation process.

classes.name: SystemCheckException
classes.description: Custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception, providing specific static methods to generate exceptions related to missing PHP extensions during the system check phase.

methods.name: notEnabledPDOExtension
methods.description: Static method that returns an instance of SystemCheckException with a message prompting to enable the PHP PDO extension.
